messages.content: 一輛汽車最初靜止，然後以3 m/s^2的恆定加速度開始移動。5秒後，它的最終速度是多少？現在，想像一個頻率為50 Hz，波長為3公尺的波。這個波的速度是多少？回到汽車，如果它繼續以相同的加速度移動另外7秒，從起點到現在總共走了多遠？

function.name: kinematics_distance
function.description: Find the distance traveled by an object moving under constant acceleration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds the object has been moving. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. Default value is -9.81 (Earth's gravity) This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_final_velocity
function.description: Find the final velocity of an object moving under constant acceleration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds the object has been moving. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. Default value is -9.81 (Earth's gravity) This is a float type value.

function.name: physics_wave_velocity
function.description: Calculate the velocity of a wave based on its frequency and wavelength. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

frequency.description: The frequency of the wave in Hz. This is a float type value.

wavelength.description: The wavelength of the wave in m. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to use the provided tools. The user asks three questions:

1. Final velocity after 5 seconds with initial velocity 0 and acceleration 3 m/s^2. Use kinematics_final_velocity.

2. Wave velocity with frequency 50 Hz and wavelength 3 m. Use physics_wave_velocity.

3. Distance traveled after continuing 7 more seconds at same acceleration from rest? Actually after 5 seconds it has some velocity, but they say "if it continues with same acceleration for another 7 seconds". So total time 12 seconds. But we can compute distance traveled during the additional 7 seconds starting from velocity after 5 seconds. But easier: compute total distance after 12 seconds from rest. Use kinematics_distance with initial_velocity 0, time 12, acceleration 3. That gives total distance from start. Then subtract distance after 5 seconds to get distance traveled during last 7 seconds? But question: "從起點到現在總共走了多遠?" Means from start to now total distance. So just total distance after 12 seconds. So use kinematics_distance with time 12.

Thus we need to call kinematics_final_velocity with initial_velocity 0, time 5, acceleration 3. Then physics_wave_velocity with frequency 50, wavelength 3. Then kinematics_distance with initial_velocity 0, time 12, acceleration 3.

We should call each tool separately.
